display_information.name: NLog Check-In
display_information.description: Publishes Alchemy Dev Mon/Wed/Fri contractor check-ins from NLog to the Output Reporting Channel. Status reports — not timesheets.
display_information.long_description:
NLog Check-In is the Slack companion for NLog (nlog.kaila-app.com) — the Alchemy Dev invoice and worklog app.

Contractors draft thrice-weekly productivity reports (Section 7) in NLog, then post them to the Output Reporting Channel. Reports follow the Monday / Wednesday / Friday format: what you're working on, completed deliverables, pending work, blockers with a Point Person, help/confirmation asks, and ETAs.

• Cadence: Mon, Wed, Fri before 9:00 PM Asia/Manila
• Saves before 9:00 AM PHT schedule the Slack post for 8:55 PM PHT
• Completed must match billable worklogs
• Local Prefill does not consume AI quota

This bot only posts check-ins; you compose and submit from the Check-in tab in NLog.
